title: say in the reviewer brief that shell variables in commands are denied, so reviewers use literal absolute paths from the start

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261119-150234-f362, project ork, item S346:

say in the reviewer brief that shell variables in commands are denied, so reviewers use literal absolute paths from the start

Evidence: a Bash call that used W=... and $W was auto-denied with "A variable in this command can't be checked before it runs"
